dct_description_sm: Geographical numbers, climate demarcations, and linear parallels indicated along margins.
Appears in Waldseemüller's edition of Ptolemy's Geographia, Strasbourg: Johannes Schott, 1513.
This copy has pencil inscription in lower left: 218.
